unit: platform account post ID; not necessarily a unique presidential statement

fields.timestamp_basis: Source timestamp or explicit ID-derived timestamp
fields.repost_id: Original quoted/reposted ID if source provides it; nullable
fields.quote_id: Quote target ID if source provides it; nullable
fields.sources: Source name and verified archive URL
fields.text_sha256: SHA-256 of privately retained normalized account text
fields.duplicate_of: Earlier original ID if explicit repost or exact text repeated within 24h
fields.dcpd_overlap_candidates: GovInfo document IDs with same-day textual overlap; manual event review needed

private_analysis_fields.text: Preserved account text from preferred source, or clearly labeled APP editorial fallback
private_analysis_fields.authored_text_candidate: Reposts and pure quote references removed; shared headlines/attributed quotations still require manual review
private_analysis_fields.media_urls: Original media pointers; no transcription claim
private_analysis_fields.media_archive_screenshot: Archive-rendered screenshot pointer, not independently verified original media
